body.name: imported exact partial-transport identification mapping
body.construction: Use the established theorem \(\mathfrak I_{\mathrm{PT}}\) from \(\texttt{CausalSmithPartialTransport2026}\): map the observed raw capacities \(w_n\) to \(\Pi_+w_n\), then to \(M_n\), \(N_{L,n}\), and \(N_{U,n}\), and hence to the exact closed sharp set \(\Theta_{I,n}=[N_{L,n}/M_n,N_{U,n}/M_n]\).
